Row.Text: Electricity
Have 4 Coal or Oil Resources, in any combination.
Nothing turns without something to burn — a share of its research is already complete.
Urbanization
Build City Parks in 3 settlements.
The crowded city still needs somewhere to breathe — a share of its research is already complete.
Combustion
Extract an Artifact.
What the earth kept, the engine age dug up — a share of its research is already complete.
Industrialization
Have a Factory Town with 3 Resources assigned to it.
One town gave up everything else to feed the works — a share of its research is already complete.
Radio
Run 3 Espionage actions this Age.
Every broadcast is also a chance to listen in — a share of its research is already complete.
Flight
Reveal the whole map.
You cannot fly over a world you have never seen — a share of its research is already complete.
Mass Production
Have 2 settlements connected by Railroad.
The line only moves as fast as the rails that feed it — a share of its research is already complete.
Computation
Have a Laboratory and a Schoolhouse on the same tile.
Teaching and calculating on one block — a share of its research is already complete.
Mobilization
Defeat 3 units with Air units this Age.
The whole war moves at the speed of the air arm — a share of its research is already complete.
Armor
Defeat an enemy Commander this Age.
The line breaks where the armor reaches the headquarters — a share of its research is already complete.
Aerodynamics
Have a Biplane, a Trench Fighter and a Bomber at the same time. Unique replacements count.
Three shapes in the air teach more than three of one — a share of its research is already complete.
Nuclear Fission
Build Oxford University.
The atom is split in a lecture hall long before a desert — a share of its research is already complete.
Rocketry
Have an Aerodrome and a Laboratory in your Capital.
A launch needs an airfield and a laboratory in the same place — a share of its research is already complete.
Political Theory
Research a node in your civilization's unique civics tree.
Every people argues its own case first — a share of its research is already complete.
Globalism
Be engaged in diplomacy with every leader you have met.
No one is left off the table — a share of its research is already complete.
Nationalism
Declare a Formal War.
A nation at war wants a reason it can name — a share of its research is already complete.
Capitalism
Have a Stock Exchange adjacent to both a Port and a Rail Station.
Money sits where the sea route meets the rail head — a share of its research is already complete.
Militarism
Have Defensive Fortifications in all your Cities.
The state stands behind its walls everywhere at once — a share of its research is already complete.
Hegemony
Build 3 Open-Air Museums.
Rule shows in what you are allowed to build — a share of its research is already complete.
Liberalism
Be at peace with every major civilization on turn 20 of the Modern Age.
Liberty is what a long quiet buys — a share of its research is already complete.
Progressivism
Hold +4 War Support against your opponent.
Reform carries the country with it — a share of its research is already complete.
Radicalism
Be at war with 2 major civilizations at once.
A creed that thrives on enemies never lacks for them — a share of its research is already complete.
Absolutism
Raze 2 settlements.
Some rule is made plain by what it removes — a share of its research is already complete.
Centralism
Have 5 Farming or Fishing Towns.
The plan decides what the countryside is for — a share of its research is already complete.
Socialism
Have a Tenement in all your Cities.
Housing for all of them, not a showpiece for one — a share of its research is already complete.
